meta.name: Detective Byomkesh Bakshy!
meta.description: Byomkesh, fresh out of college, agrees to investigate the disappearance of Bhuvan, a chemist. Assisted by Bhuvan's son Ajit, Byomkesh links the case to a larger conspiracy that will unsettle Calcutta.
meta.slogan: 1943 Calcutta... a war... a mystery... and a detective...
